title: Reliable Deposit Processor — Enterprise Observability & Chaos Control
description: End-to-End Prometheus Observability Dashboard covering SLA, Latency Waterfall (with Exemplars), Live Scaling & Chaos Resilience, Two-Phase PostgreSQL Settlement, and Resource Saturation.

panels.title: 1. Executive & Financial Integrity SLA (نوار سلامت مالی و SLA کلان)
Ledger Discrepancy (مغایرت مالی)
panels.description: Must strictly equal 0. Compares settled deposits sum against user wallet balances in PostgreSQL.

panels.title: Cluster Accepted RPS (نرخ واریز موفق)
panels.description: Real-time rate of 202 Accepted deposit requests across all Gateway replicas.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Error Ratio (نرخ خطای ۵xx)
panels.description: Percentage of HTTP 5xx responses on the Gateway over total requests.

panels.title: E2E Event Age p99 (تأخیر کل مسیر)
panels.description: 99th percentile end-to-end latency from Gateway created_at timestamp to PostgreSQL ingestion commit.

panels.title: NATS Consumer Lag (عقب‌افتادگی صف)
panels.description: Total unprocessed messages in NATS JetStream (num_pending + num_ack_pending) for deposits_processor.

panels.title: Unsettled DB Backlog (در انتظار تسویه)
panels.description: Rows in deposits table with is_settled = FALSE waiting for the 5-second PL/pgSQL settlement cycle.

panels.title: Time Since Settlement (سن آخرین تسویه)
panels.description: Seconds elapsed since the most recent successful settle_pending_deposits() execution (normal <= 6s).

panels.title: Targets UP / TSDB Series (سلامت و سری‌ها)
panels.description: Total active time-series in Prometheus TSDB (must stay < 5,000 to prove zero cardinality explosion).

panels.title: 2. End-to-End Latency Waterfall & Bottleneck Localization (آبشار تأخیر و مکان‌یابی گلوگاه)
p99 Latency Breakdown Across Every Hop (مقایسه p99 هر لایه برای کشف گلوگاه)
panels.description: Compares 99th percentile latency at each stage: Gateway HTTP -> gRPC Client -> Publisher NATS PubAck -> Depositor SQL UNNEST -> End-to-End Event Age.

panels.title: Gateway HTTP Quantiles (p50 / p95 / p99) + Request ID Exemplars
panels.description: HTTP latency percentiles on POST /v1/deposits with OpenMetrics request_id Exemplars enabled.

panels.title: End-to-End Event Age Quantiles (p50 / p95 / p99) (تأخیر کل مسیر تا دیتابیس)
panels.description: Time elapsed from Gateway request reception (created_at) to PostgreSQL deposits table commit.

panels.title: 3. Chaos Engineering, Live Scaling & Load Balancing (توزیع بار، تغییر مقیاس زنده و تاب‌آوری آشوب)
Publisher gRPC Throughput by Replica Instance (توزیع متوازن بار بین رپلیکاها)
panels.description: Shows per-replica RPC rate. When scaling Publisher between 1 and 6 replicas, new instances join within seconds via swarmdns.

panels.title: Depositor Ingestion Rate by Replica Instance (نرخ پردازش هر نود Depositor)
panels.description: Messages committed per second by each Depositor replica from the shared durable NATS consumer.

panels.title: Chaos Absorption: Gateway gRPC Auto-Retries vs Client 5xx & Discovered Endpoints
panels.description: During SIGKILL chaos, gateway_grpc_retries_total spikes to absorb transient Unavailable errors so client-facing 5xx stays 0.

panels.title: 4. Gateway Traffic, Security Guards & Multi-Layer Idempotency (ترافیک ورودی، امنیت و سپر ضدتکرار)
Gateway Deposit Requests by Business Result (تفکیک نتایج درخواست‌های واریز)
panels.description: Breakdown of gateway_deposit_requests_total across accepted, duplicate, invalid, unauthorized, rate_limited, payload_too_large, and upstream errors.

panels.title: Gateway HTTP Requests by Route & Status Code (ضد انفجار Cardinality با route=unmatched)
panels.description: All unknown 404 paths coalesce into route="unmatched" to prevent TSDB series explosion.

panels.title: Defense-in-Depth Deduplication & Poison-Pill DLQ Rate (سپرهای ضدتکرار و صف DLQ)
panels.description: Tracks duplicates neutralized at Gateway, NATS JetStream, and PostgreSQL, plus invalid messages isolated in DEPOSITS_DLQ.

panels.title: 5. Two-Phase PostgreSQL Engine: UNNEST Micro-Batching & Periodic Settlement (موتور دو مرحله‌ای دیتابیس)
Sawtooth Settlement Wave: Unsettled Backlog vs Settled Rate (موج دندانه‌اره‌ای تسویه ۵ ثانیه‌ای)
panels.description: Shows unsettled rows accumulating over 5 seconds during fast UNNEST ingestion and dropping to 0 on each settle_pending_deposits() run.

panels.title: SQL UNNEST Micro-Batch Size Distribution (p50 / p95 / p99) (اندازه بچ‌های درج دسته‌ای)
panels.description: Number of deposit events coalesced into a single SQL UNNEST query (up to 256 events per batch).

panels.title: PL/pgSQL Batch Settlement Execution Duration (p50 / p95 / p99) (زمان اجرای تابع تسویه)
panels.description: Execution time of settle_pending_deposits(100000) inside PostgreSQL.

panels.title: 6. Saturation, Database Connection Pool & Go Runtime (اشباع منابع، کانکشن‌های دیتابیس و Go Runtime)
PostgreSQL Connection Pool Saturation (go_sql_* Collectors)
panels.description: Tracks open, in-use, and idle SQL connections across Depositor & Dashboard replicas vs max pool capacity.

panels.title: Concurrency Saturation: In-Flight Requests & Active Depositor Workers
panels.description: Real-time concurrent requests in Gateway & Publisher alongside active JetStream workers in Depositor.

panels.title: Go Runtime Memory & Goroutines by Service (پایداری حافظه در مقیاس ۵ میلیون درخواست)
panels.description: Proves bounded heap memory and zero goroutine leaks across all 4 microservices.
